user.title: Connect to Sevenhugs Smart Remote
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your Sevenhugs Smart Remote.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered Sevenhugs Smart Remote
zeroconf_confirm.description: Discovered Sevenhugs Smart Remote (Serial: {sn}) at {host}. Do you want to pair this remote?

pair_init.title: Pairing Initialization
pair_init.description:
Make sure your remote's screen is turned on. When you click Next, Home Assistant will request a pairing PIN.

Note: The remote's microcontroller takes about 16 seconds to calculate its security code.
Look at your remote's screen for an 8-digit PIN (format XXX-XX-XXX).

pair_pin.title: Enter Remote PIN Code
pair_pin.description: Look at your Smart Remote screen. Enter the 8-digit PIN code displayed (e.g. 123-45-678 or 12345678) before the screen turns off (~30s timeout):

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Sevenhugs Smart Remote
reconfigure.description: Update the IP address or hostname of your Sevenhugs Smart Remote.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Sevenhugs Smart Remote
reauth_confirm.description: The security session for Sevenhugs Smart Remote ({host}) is no longer valid. Do you want to re-pair it now?

error.cannot_connect: Failed to communicate with the remote. Check its IP address and Wi-Fi connection.
error.timeout_connect: The remote took too long to calculate its security code.
error.remote_busy: The remote is busy resetting its security session. Please retry.
error.invalid_pin: The PIN code entered is incorrect or has expired. The remote has reset the session: please close this dialog and restart pairing to generate a new PIN.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. The security session on the remote has expired: please close this dialog and restart.
error.already_configured: This Sevenhugs Smart Remote is already configured in Home Assistant.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please consult Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress for this device.

init.title: Sevenhugs Smart Remote Options
init.description: Configure operational settings for your Smart Remote.
